Fourteen sessions, Tuesdays 10:15–12:00, Unitobler F-112.

::: {.callout-important title="How the readings work"}
The reading listed under a session is the reading **you prepare for the following week**. It is
introduced at the end of one session and discussed at the beginning of the next. So the Sahle
text listed under Session 1 is discussed in Session 2, and so on.

Openly available texts are linked directly. Everything else — **scans in particular** — is in
the [ILIAS course
space](https://ilias.unibe.ch/ilias.php?baseClass=ilrepositorygui&cmdNode=yv:ng&cmdClass=ilObjCourseGUI&ref_id=3733960).
:::

## Literature

::: callout-tip
## Note on copyright

We try to use openly available literature wherever possible. Where that is not possible, scans
are made available in the [ILIAS course
space](https://ilias.unibe.ch/ilias.php?baseClass=ilrepositorygui&cmdNode=yv:ng&cmdClass=ilObjCourseGUI&ref_id=3733960)
for enrolled students, or the text can be obtained through the library platform
[swisscovery](https://ubbern.swisscovery.slsp.ch/discovery/search?vid=41SLSP_UBE:UBE). We advise
against using platforms such as [Library
Genesis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Library_Genesis), despite the substantive arguments in
their favour — see @karaganis2018.
:::
